name: MAA
recent: MAA Group 在 2026 财年录得约 RM107 million 的年度亏损，核数师对其持续经营能力提出重大不确定性。公司主席 Tunku Dato' Yaacob Khyra 在 11 月闭市期间多次增持公司股份。公司也发布了 2026 年报。
notable: 核数师对 MAA Group 的财务报表发出与持续经营相关的重大不确定性意见。
主席 Tunku Dato' Yaacob Khyra 在 2026 年 11 月闭市期间多次增持公司股份。
以回购最多 10% 的已发行股份。
risks: 核数师对集团持续经营能力发出重大不确定性意见。

recent_en: MAA Group reported an annual loss of about RM107 million for FY2026, with its auditor flagging material uncertainty over going concern. Chairman Tunku Dato' Yaacob Khyra acquired shares multiple times during the November closed period.
notable_en: The auditor issued a material uncertainty related to going concern opinion on MAA Group's financial statements.
Chairman Tunku Dato' Yaacob Khyra acquired shares multiple times during the November 2026 closed period.
The company proposed renewing the shareholders' mandate to purchase up to 10% of its issued shares.
risks_en: The auditor flagged material uncertainty over the group's going concern ability.
The group recorded an annual loss of about RM107 million for FY2026.
